# Zscaler web overview â€” ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSWebLogsOverview.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

parameters.name: SourceIP
parameters.label: Source IP
parameters.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'

| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize Count=count() by Value=tostring(SrcIpAddr)
| order by Count desc
| project Value,Label=strcat(Value,' count: ',Count)
| take 250

parameters.name: DestinationIP
parameters.label: Destination IP
parameters.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'

| where isnotempty(DstIpAddr)
| summarize Count=count() by Value=tostring(DstIpAddr)
| order by Count desc
| project Value,Label=strcat(Value,' count: ',Count)
| take 250

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| extend DestinationServiceName=tostring(AdditionalFields['Application'])
| where isnotempty(DestinationServiceName)
| summarize Count=count() by DestinationServiceName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Apps being accessed

content.query:
let data=materialize(
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where isnotempty(NetworkApplicationProtocol));
let appData=data
| extend ApplicationProtocol=NetworkApplicationProtocol
| summarize TotalCount=count() by ApplicationProtocol
| join kind=inner (data | extend ApplicationProtocol=NetworkApplicationProtocol | make-series Trend=count() default=0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start},{TimeRange:end},{TimeRange:grain}) by ApplicationProtocol) on ApplicationProtocol
| extend Id=strcat('protocol-',hash_sha256(ApplicationProtocol)),Name=ApplicationProtocol,Type='ApplicationProtocol',ParentId=''
| project Id,Name,Type,['ApplicationProtocol Count']=TotalCount,Trend,ParentId;
let methodData=data
| where isnotempty(HttpRequestMethod)
| extend ApplicationProtocol=NetworkApplicationProtocol,RequestMethod=HttpRequestMethod
| summarize TotalCount=count() by ApplicationProtocol,RequestMethod
| join kind=inner (data | where isnotempty(HttpRequestMethod) | extend ApplicationProtocol=NetworkApplicationProtocol,RequestMethod=HttpRequestMethod | make-series Trend=count() default=0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start},{TimeRange:end},{TimeRange:grain}) by ApplicationProtocol,RequestMethod) on ApplicationProtocol,RequestMethod
| extend Id=strcat('method-',hash_sha256(strcat(ApplicationProtocol,'|',RequestMethod))),Name=RequestMethod,Type='RequestMethod',ParentId=strcat('protocol-',hash_sha256(ApplicationProtocol))
| project Id,Name,Type,['ApplicationProtocol Count']=TotalCount,Trend,ParentId;
union methodData,appData
| order by ['ApplicationProtocol Count'] desc,Name asc
content.title: Protocols and methods

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where EventResult =~ 'Success' and isnotempty(HttpRequestMethod) and HttpRequestMethod != 'None'
| summarize count() by RequestMethod=HttpRequestMethod
content.title: Allowed HTTP methods

| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure' and tostring(AdditionalFields['Location']) =~ 'Road Warrior'
| summarize URLS_BLOCKED=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}),Activity=EventResultDetails
content.title: Block reasons for road warriors

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| extend DstFQDN=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('DstFQDN','')),tostring(column_ifexists('DstFQDN_string','')),tostring(column_ifexists('DstFQDN_dynamic','')),tostring(AdditionalFields['DstFQDN']),tostring(parse_url(Url).Host))
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure' and isnotempty(DstFQDN)
| summarize Count=count() by DestinationHostName=DstFQDN
| top 10 by Count desc
content.title: Top blocked domains for HTTP/S requests

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure'
| extend DestinationHostName=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('DstFQDN','')),tostring(column_ifexists('DstFQDN_string','')),tostring(column_ifexists('DstFQDN_dynamic','')),tostring(AdditionalFields['DstFQDN']),tostring(parse_url(Url).Host)),SourceUserName=SrcUsername,Activity=EventResultDetails,DestinationIP=DstIpAddr,Location=tostring(AdditionalFields['Location'])
| where ('{DestinationHostName}' == 'All' or DestinationHostName == '{DestinationHostName}') and ('{SourceUserName}' == 'All' or SourceUserName == '{SourceUserName}') and ('{Activity}' == 'All' or Activity == '{Activity}')

| order by Count desc
content.title: Block activities summary
